decisions.reason: F5 overstates clause (iii) of lem-divided-power-half-has-integral-skew-string-coefficients, whose statement quantifies over U_A^-; step 4.1 used that identity for arbitrary U_q^- without an extension. F5 is now restricted accurately and step 4.1 proves the extension: every F-generator word belongs to U_A^-, these words span U_q^- over Q(q), and the coefficient maps are field-linear with finite sums. The projection, deletion formula, Gaussian cancellation, uniqueness, shift identities and integral preservation remain valid; no integral freeness or choice is used.

The parenthetical in step 2.2 falsely assigns u_(m-1) at every shifted position, including a killed bottom. For a trivial string its claimed coefficient is v at m=1 although f-tilde(v)=0. The preceding restricted sum and resulting bottom-projection identity are correct, so this is a nonfatal coefficient-description defect. The repair sets v_0=0 and v_m=u_(m-1) only for m<=a_(m-1), and zero otherwise. Uniqueness, weights, both kernel identities, naturality and the interior comparison follow from admissible finite strings, with no extra choice or bounded-support assumption.

In step 1.2, Delta E_2 acting on the summand q e_2 tensor e_3 contributes q e_2 tensor E_2 e_3. The displayed expansion omitted q although its result [2]v_22 was correct. Inserting q repairs this nonfatal computational typo. Exact Laurent arithmetic independently checked all 24 E_i/F_i actions; the six distinct labels, divided strings, cyclicity, crystal lattice, six edges and all twelve epsilon/phi equalities follow from that table. The Example interface and prerequisites are unchanged.

Step 1.1 incorrectly identifies U_q^-[-alpha] with the field extension of a lattice by tensoring a lattice projection: this only identifies the two lattice field spans. The repair proves ambient spanning directly, following the grand-loop field-spanning paragraph: F_i x=f-tilde_i(sum_n [n+1]_i F_i^(n)x_n), with its input in the preceding degree, so induction from the unit spans every field component by lowering words. Clearing A_0 denominators proves injectivity. Explicit least-index component bases avoid simultaneous choice. H/I/J/K and e-tilde f-tilde=id establish the crystal axioms and ranks; raising compatibility retains the survival restriction. Step 2.1 also explicitly proves that zero is attained, by projecting a nonzero infinite half-string beyond a finite module string. Statement and AC boundary are unchanged.
